text:
Maya (Finance): Heads up — customer bluefrost-io flagged a lower-than-expected token total on invoice 3389. Their ingest logs show ~3.2M tokens; our invoice shows 2.1M. Can we triage quickly?
Ravi (Platform): which window?
Maya (Finance): 2026-03-28 22:10-22:30 UTC for their primary stream.
Sofia (Billing): that’s ~1.1M tokens missing (~$66). Any automated alerts?
talia-devops: checking, I see a rate-cap override applied at 22:14 UTC on edge-proxy-asia-1: `suppress_billable=true` during a short maintenance. Looks like suppression logic also toggled for forwarded acks.
Ravi (Platform): oh — we rolled a hotfix to suppress rate-cap chargebacks but it accidentally suppressed ack->metering events for that tenant for ~4m. Bad selector.
metering-bot: auto-detect -> ingest-suppression stream=bluefrost-io window=2026-03-28T22:12:00Z-2026-03-28T22:18:00Z suppressed_tokens=1,067,400 ticket=INC-2026-331 created.
Maya (Finance): options: 1) re-run metering backfill to recompute tokens, may take 1-2 hours and needs platform sign-off; 2) provisional invoice credit for the delta.
Sofia (Billing): provisional credit OK up to $70 pending reprocess. We'll hold the credit as provisional line item on invoice 3389.
Ravi (Platform): reprocess plan: run idempotent replay on archived events using msg_id dedupe. SQL to find affected messages:
```
select msg_id, count(*) as ct, sum(tokens) as tokens
from archived_ingest
where tenant='bluefrost-io' and ts >= '2026-03-28T22:10:00Z' and ts <= '2026-03-28T22:30:00Z'
group by msg_id
having max(suppressed_flag)=1;
```
Maya (Finance): please attach audit CSV of msg_id and tokens to BILL-ADJ ticket if you run backfill.
ingest-audit-bot: audit snapshot created at 2026-03-28T23:00:00Z path=s3://metering-audit/bluefrost/2026-03-28/suppressed-snapshot.csv
Ravi (Platform): estimate reprocess 60-90 mins; will run only after finance signs off. Need to ensure no double-counting if upstream retried; replay will use msg_id de-dupe.
Sofia (Billing): authorize reprocess. We keep provisional credit until reprocess completes. If reprocess confirms tokens, we reverse the provisional credit and invoice as normal.
Maya (Finance): approved — please run and post final delta here. Also add a follow-up task to tighten the suppression selector.
Ravi (Platform): acknowledged. Filed PLATFORM-5478 to fix selector and add unit tests.
Maya (Finance): created BILL-ADJ-611 and linked INC-2026-331 and PLATFORM-5478. Thanks all :+1:
Sofia (Billing): provisional credit noted on invoice 3389 for $70. Will update once reprocess finishes.
